source_format: GSE70138 Level 5 COMPZ normalized z-like scores, not raw log fold changes
Classic_KS: unweighted KS pair, zero if same-signed ES, otherwise ES_UP-ES_DOWN
Zhang: signed absolute-rank dot product normalized by sum of top ranks; adapted to COMPZ input
XSum: signed sum over top 150 absolute COMPZ values; adapted to COMPZ input
Tau: NOT_AVAILABLE: no independent disease-query reference set
NCS: NOT_CALCULATED: reference distribution must be audited separately
